benefits_section.summary: This product offers Brightening, and Fades dark spots.

steps: Cleanse your face thoroughly and pat dry
Gently massage the serum onto your face and neck
Wait for the serum to fully absorb (1-2 minutes)
Follow with sunscreen (essential when using Vitamin C)
tips: Store in a cool, dark place to maintain Vitamin C potency
Use within 3-6 months of opening for maximum effectiveness
This lightweight formula is ideal for oily skin and won't clog pores
Focus application on areas that need brightening, avoiding overly dry patches
Perform a patch test before first use
Start with once daily application and increase as tolerated

precautions: Perform a patch test on your inner arm before first use
Avoid contact with eyes; rinse thoroughly if contact occurs
Those with sensitive skin should start with alternate-day application
warnings: May increase sun sensitivity - always use sunscreen during the day
Keep out of reach of children
